chunks: Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz and Abdullah ibn Sinan asked Abu Abdullah عليه السلام.
about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"So when the salat (prayer) has been concluded, then disperse in the land and seek from the bounty of Allah."
So he عليه السلام said: "The salat (prayer) is on the day of Friday, and the dispersal is on the day of Saturday."

key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: the salat (prayer), here interpreted as the Friday prayer context
key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the land, meaning the places in which people go forth
key_terms.فَانْتَشِرُوا: disperse or spread out after worship
key_terms.فَضْلِ اللَّهِ: the bounty of Allah, meaning provision and livelihood

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام mean by the verse, "When the salat is concluded, disperse in the land and seek from the bounty of Allah"?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a tafsir of the verse concerning dispersing in the land after the salat (prayer). Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains it in connection with Friday and Saturday, indicating a specific understanding of the verse in relation to the timing of communal worship and then going forth for livelihood.
